# 1 Chronicles Chapter 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 370v–371v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/1CH_002_page_001.jpg, 1CH_002_page_002.jpg, 1CH_002_page_003.jpg

---

**2:1** These [are] the-sons of-Yisra'el: Re'uven, Shim'on, Levi, and-Yehudah, Yissakhar, and-Zevulun, **2:2** Dan, Yosef, and-Binyamin, Naftali, Gad, and-Asher.

**2:3** The-sons of-Yehudah: Er, and-Onan, and-Shelah — three were-born to-him from-the-daughter of-Shu'a the-Kena'anit. And-was Er, the-firstborn of-Yehudah, evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, and-he-killed-him.

**2:4** And-Tamar his-daughter-in-law bore to-him Perets and-Zerach. All the-sons of-Yehudah [were] five.

**2:5** The-sons of-Perets: Chetsron, and-Chamul. **2:6** And-the-sons of-Zerach: Zimri, and-Etan, and-Heyman, and-Kalkol, and-Dara — five of-them in-all.

**2:7** And-the-sons of-Karmi: Akhar, the-troubler [okher] of-Yisra'el, who committed-treachery [ma'al] in-the-devoted-thing [ba-cherem].

**2:8** And-the-sons of-Etan: Azaryah.

**2:9** And-the-sons of-Chetsron who were-born to-him: Yerachme'el, and-Ram, and-Keluvay.

**2:10** And-Ram fathered Amminadav, and-Amminadav fathered Nachshon, prince [nasi] of-the-sons of-Yehudah. **2:11** And-Nachshon fathered Salma, and-Salma fathered Bo'az. **2:12** And-Bo'az fathered Oved, and-Oved fathered Yishay.

**2:13** And-Yishay fathered his-firstborn Eli'av, and-Avinadav the-second, and-Shim'a the-third, **2:14** Netan'el the-fourth, Raddai the-fifth, **2:15** Otsem the-sixth, David the-seventh. **2:16** And-their-sisters: Tseruyah, and-Avigayil. And-the-sons of-Tseruyah: Avshai, and-Yo'av, and-Asa'el — three.

**2:17** And-Avigayil bore Amasa, and-the-father of-Amasa [was] Yeter the-Yishme'eli.

**2:18** And-Kalev son of-Chetsron fathered [children] with-Azuvah [his] wife and-with-Yeri'ot. And-these [are] her sons: Yesher, and-Shovav, and-Ardon. **2:19** And-died Azuvah, and-took to-him Kalev Efrat, and-she-bore to-him Chur. **2:20** And-Chur fathered Uri, and-Uri fathered Betsal'el.

**2:21** And-afterward came Chetsron to the-daughter of-Makhir, father of-Gil'ad, and-he took-her — and-he [was] a-son of-sixty years — and-she-bore to-him Seguv. **2:22** And-Seguv fathered Ya'ir, and-he-had twenty-three cities in-the-land of-Gil'ad.

**2:23** And-took Geshur and-Aram the-towns of-Ya'ir [Chavvot Ya'ir] from-them, and-Qenat and-its-daughters [benoteyha], sixty cities. All these [were] the-sons of-Makhir, father of-Gil'ad.

**2:24** And-after the-death of-Chetsron in-Kalev-Efratah, and-the-wife of-Chetsron [was] Aviyyah, and-she-bore to-him Ashchur, the-father of-Teqo'a.

**2:25** And-the-sons of-Yerachme'el, the-firstborn of-Chetsron: the-firstborn Ram, and-Bunah, and-Oren, and-Otsem, Achiyyah. **2:26** And-was to-Yerachme'el another wife, and-her-name [was] Atarah; she [was] the-mother of-Onam. **2:27** And-the-sons of-Ram, the-firstborn of-Yerachme'el: Ma'ats, and-Yamin, and-Eqer. **2:28** And-the-sons of-Onam: Shammai, and-Yada. And-the-sons of-Shammai: Nadav, and-Avishur. **2:29** And-the-name of-the-wife of-Avishur [was] Avi'chayil, and-she-bore to-him Achban and-Molid. **2:30** And-the-sons of-Nadav: Seled, and-Appayim. And-died Seled without sons [lo vanim]. **2:31** And-the-sons of-Appayim: Yish'i. And-the-sons of-Yish'i: Sheshan. And-the-sons of-Sheshan: Achlai.

**2:32** And-the-sons of-Yada, brother of-Shammai: Yeter, and-Yonatan. And-died Yeter without sons. **2:33** And-the-sons of-Yonatan: Pelet, and-Zaza. These were the-sons of-Yerachme'el.

**2:34** And-not was to-Sheshan sons, but daughters. And-to-Sheshan [was] a-servant [eved], an-Egyptian [mitsri], and-his-name [was] Yarcha. **2:35** And-gave Sheshan his-daughter to-Yarcha his-servant as-a-wife, and-she-bore to-him Attai. **2:36** And-Attai fathered Natan, and-Natan fathered Zavad, **2:37** and-Zavad fathered Eflal, and-Eflal fathered Oved, **2:38** and-Oved fathered Yehu, and-Yehu fathered Azaryah, **2:39** and-Azaryah fathered Chelets, and-Chelets fathered El'asah, **2:40** and-El'asah fathered Sismai, and-Sismai fathered Shallum, **2:41** and-Shallum fathered Yeqamyah, and-Yeqamyah fathered Elishama.

**2:42** And-the-sons of-Kalev, brother of-Yerachme'el: Mesha his-firstborn — he [was] the-father of-Zif — and-the-sons of-Mareshah, father of-Chevron. **2:43** And-the-sons of-Chevron: Qorach, and-Tappuach, and-Reqem, and-Shema. **2:44** And-Shema fathered Racham, father of-Yorqe'am. And-Reqem fathered Shammai. **2:45** And-the-son of-Shammai [was] Ma'on, and-Ma'on [was] the-father of-Beit-Tsur.

**2:46** And-Eifah, concubine of-Kalev, bore Charan, and-Motsa, and-Gazez. And-Charan fathered Gazez. **2:47** And-the-sons of-Yahdai: Regem, and-Yotam, and-Geshan, and-Pelet, and-Eifah, and-Sha'af. **2:48** The-concubine of-Kalev, Ma'akhah, bore Shever, and-Tirchanah. **2:49** And-she-bore Sha'af, father of-Madmannah, Sheva, father of-Makhbenah and-father of-Giv'a. And-the-daughter of-Kalev [was] Akhsah.

**2:50** These were the-sons of-Kalev. The-sons of-Chur, the-firstborn of-Efratah: Shoval, father of-Qiryat-Ye'arim, **2:51** Salma, father of-Beit-Lechem, Charef, father of-Beit-Gader. **2:52** And-were to-Shoval, father of-Qiryat-Ye'arim, sons: ha-Ro'eh, half of-the-Menuchot. **2:53** And-the-families of-Qiryat-Ye'arim: the-Yitri, and-the-Puti, and-the-Shumati, and-the-Mishra'i. From-these came-out the-Tsor'ati and-the-Eshta'uli.

**2:54** The-sons of-Salma: Beit-Lechem, and-the-Netofati, Atrot Beit-Yo'av, and-half of-the-Manachti, the-Tsor'i. **2:55** And-the-families of-scribes [sofrim] dwelling [at] Ya'bets: the-Tir'atim, the-Shim'atim, the-Sukhatim. They [are] the-Qinim who-came from-Chammat, father of-the-house of-Rekhav.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.7 — Akhar:** The Chronicler changes the name "Achan" (Joshua 7) to "Achar" — a wordplay on *okher* (troubler). The Chronicler interprets names theologically.

**v.15 — David the seventh:** In 1 Samuel 16-17, David appears as Jesse's eighth son. The Chronicler counts seven, possibly omitting one who died young. The discrepancy is unresolved.

**v.34-41 — Sheshan's Egyptian servant:** A remarkable genealogical detail — an Egyptian slave marries into the Judahite line. The Chronicler records this without comment, tracking the lineage through ten generations.

**v.55 — families of scribes:** The Kenites (*Qinim*) are linked to Hammath, father of the house of Rechab — connecting the Rechabites to a scribal tradition at Jabez. A rare glimpse into the social organization of scribal guilds.

*— EMET*
